title: Tableau Prep Flow Freshness SLA
dataSources: Tableau Prep flow runs (`tableau:prep:flow`) and Backgrounder logs.
app: Tableau Prep Conductor flow-run events from the `workgroup` repository via DB Connect and Backgrounder logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:prep:flow finish_code=0
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by flow_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>24
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Tableau Prep flow and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A flow can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Tableau Prep.
implementation: Ingest Tableau Prep success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical flow exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of flow by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Tableau Prep has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
